verdict.rationale: Mercury ships one official SDK, the Stainless-generated Go library MercuryTechnologies/mercury-go (v0.13.11, Go 1.22+). The evidence explicitly states there is no official npm or PyPI SDK, only community packages, so official SDK coverage is limited to a single language. Generated code samples in the API reference and the REST API itself are adjacent conveniences, not SDKs. Missing for 10: official TypeScript/Node and Python SDKs, a stable 1.0 SDK release, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
